text:
alex: starting a canary for the routing policy tweak — adding a fast-path that splits short requests to the new handler. rolling 2% -> 10% if green. any thoughts on early-stop criteria?
jena: quick heads-up: observed assigned vs served looks off in a small slice during smoke — assigned 2% but we only saw ~1.1% hits to canary. could be a sampling header gone missing. :thinking: 
raul: I noticed the router sometimes drops X-Route-Variant on older client versions. logs: `WARN router: missing X-Route-Variant for client=mobile/1.2.3`
alex: repro curl we used: ```bash
curl -H 'X-Client-Version: 1.2.3' -H 'X-Route-Variant: canary' 
  'https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate'
```
marta: if header loss is the culprit we should pause; SRM will bias any A/B stats. Also we should check `router.assignments.v1` metric and `router.observed.v1` to compute observed/assigned ratio by route.
jena: agree. for the stat test: small counts -> don't use chi-sq. prefer Fisher or exact binomial when n per arm is low. But we also need to account for reweighting if we try to salvage.
raul: reweighting on the fly is tempting (scale weights by 1/observed_ratio) but that inflates variance and complicates dashboard math. I'd rather pause, fix source, then re-run.
alex: open question for the console: should we auto-pause when observed/assigned < 0.8 for a given window? seems like a sane guard to avoid SRM.
marta: yes, make it configurable per-route and per-env. default 0.85 maybe. also emit a telemetry tag `srm=true` when triggered.
canary-bot: Canary rollout started by @alex at 2025-11-05T14:03:41Z (phase=1, target=2%)
jena: quick plan: 1) pause canary 2) collect router logs for the window 3) patch router to copy header from proxied requests for older clients 4) rerun canary with stratified sampling by client-version.
raul: on stratification: ensure we include `client_version` tag in assignment metrics so we can check parity per stratum. that'll help avoid a repeat.
alex: for end criteria i'm proposing: minimum 5k requests per arm AND p95 latency CI width < 40ms (bootstrap) AND error rate delta < 0.1%. if any of those fail, don't advance.
jena: note: P95 CI needs bootstrap due to heavy tail. dashboard should show bootstrap samples or a flagged approximation.
marta: on the decision to pause vs reweight: pausing is safer. reweighting is a can of worms and will show up badly in evals.
raul: agreed. stats: if SRM present, p-values are unreliable — abort analysis and label the run invalid.
alex: action items: @jena open infra ticket with logs and assign to @raul to patch router; @marta to add console guard (observed/assigned threshold) and telemetry tag; I'll abort current canary and schedule a rerun after fixes.
jena: filing infra ticket now (#INC-4821), attaching sample logs and a short reproducer. ETA 4h.
alex: canary paused by @alex at 2025-11-05T14:08:20Z :thumbsup:
marta: once patch is in, let's run a 1% sanity check for 15m before moving to full 2% to confirm parity.
raul: I'll add a metric alert: if per-stratum observed/assigned < 0.9 for 15m -> page.
alex: thanks everyone — closing this thread for now. we'll reconvene after infra ETA.
